g.text: SYS01 - Recovery to a previously working release
Acquire queue slot; validate operation and SHA
Read release image IDs, config and current migration version
Return requested release and active schema metadata
Create scratch DB at active schema version
Run compatibility suite against current schema version
[Requested version is incompatible or release is unretained]
Reject before SSH; VM remains unchanged
Prior-version reads/writes pass on scratch DB
Verify SSH host key; restore retained release
Recheck manifest and active schema version under VM lock
Select configuration revision paired with release
Previous API connects to shared database
HTTPS, API and SPA smoke checks pass
Record restored active SHA and recovery run ID
Archive sanitized recovery logs and manifest
Rollback successful; release queue slot released
Rollback does not rebuild images or modify/restore the shared database.
The requested version must pass compatibility against the current schema
in an isolated scratch database before the VM is changed. The concurrency
slot remains held through verification, activation and archival.
